spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the core practical reason to use object-fit and object-position on <object>: panning and cropping an intrinsic 360x220 SVG schematic inside a 240x150 host while preserving scriptable access to internal SVG nodes via objectEl.contentDocument.

interactive.rationale: Provides subsystem preset buttons, X/Y object-position percentage sliders, object-fit selector, and clickable SVG nodes inside contentDocument that highlight the target node and inspect its getBBox() and getScreenCTM().

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index blurb promising an object-fit / object-position focal-point cropper over a DOM-inspectable <object> diagram.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers switching between 1:1 cropping (object-fit: none), full-bleed scaling (object-fit: cover), and letterboxed overview (object-fit: contain) across all corners of the SVG coordinate system.

references.rationale: Links to https://chromestatus.com/feature/4886345347629056 and the WHATWG HTML embedded content rendering specification.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified preset buttons, slider updates, contentDocument node highlighting, and responsive layout across 360px mobile and 1280px desktop viewports.

telemetry_health.rationale: Calls showcaseTelemetry.assert('focal-point-cropper-updated') with active node and CSS focal coordinates and zero console errors.

design_system.rationale: Uses CSS variables from /public/styles.css and named SVG colors (ivory, royalblue, teal, darkslategray, crimson, black) with zero raw hex/rgba/hsla colors.

accessibility.rationale: All sliders, selects, and buttons have explicit labels and >=44px tap targets, <object> has title and aria-label, and <output> uses aria-live='polite'.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Uses max-width: 100% on #schematic-object and auto-fit minmax(240px, 1fr) grid columns so narrow 360px viewports have zero horizontal overflow.

guidanceConsulted.query: defer rendering heavy content below the fold
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Apply content-visibility: auto with contain-intrinsic-size to below-the-fold sections.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied .deferred-section to the code path and see-also sections.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible range sliders and select controls
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair every slider and select with a visible <label> and enforce 44px minimum touch height.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Associated #crop-fit-select, #pos-x-range, and #pos-y-range with explicit <label> elements and min-height: 44px.

guidanceConsulted.query: keyboard alternatives for interactive SVG contentDocument nodes
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Provide top-level keyboard-accessible buttons that trigger the same state changes as clicking inside embedded SVG subtrees.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Provided top-level Focus buttons (#focus-ingress, #focus-router, #focus-storage) alongside direct SVG node click handlers.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive two-column cropper layout on 360px mobile viewports
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)) and max-width: 100% on replaced elements.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied .cropper-layout auto-fit grid and max-width: 100% on #schematic-object.

summary: Interactive SVG focal-point cropper demonstrating CSS object-fit and object-position paired with live objectEl.contentDocument DOM inspection.
